shapes.description: Named vector symbols, referenced from targets.json by plotShape and historyTrailShape.shape. A name may contain '/' so it reads like a sprite frame name, for example 'sct/aircraft'.

point.description: A point in design units: logical pixels at 100% DPI, origin at the symbol anchor, +x right and +y DOWN (screen convention, matching a EuroScope GDI listing).

color.description: Literal colour as [r, g, b] or [r, g, b, a], each 0-255. A literal is never overridden by the variant's plotColor.

strokeWidth.description: Default stroke width in design units for every element that does not set its own.

pixelSnap.description: Snap axis-aligned strokes and fill edges to the physical pixel grid so a 1px stroke lands on exactly one pixel column at full alpha. Turn off for smooth sub-pixel motion instead of maximum crispness.

rotateWithHeading.description: Set false on a rotation-invariant glyph to ignore heading rotation from whatever uses it. Omit to inherit the caller's rotation.

sizeMode.description: Design units are logical pixels, scaled by DPI at draw time. 'world' (metres, scaling with zoom) is not implemented yet.

color.description: Fallback colour for elements that inherit and whose variant supplies no plotColor.

element.description: Exactly one of line, polygon, circle, rect, dot or shapeRef.

line.description: Polyline. Transcribing GDI, MOVETO x0 y0 / LINETO x1 y1 is one line element; GDI's LineTo excludes its endpoint, so MOVETO -4 -4 / LINETO 5 5 becomes [[-4, -4], [4, 4]].

polygon.description: Closed polygon. GDI POLYGON -1 -1 -1 1 1 1 1 -1 becomes [[-1, -1], [-1, 1], [1, 1], [1, -1]]. Set fill true to fill it; only axis-aligned rectangles can be filled today, other polygons draw as an outline.

start.description: Arc start in degrees, 0 = up, clockwise. Omit both start and end for a full circle.

end.description: Arc end in degrees, 0 = up, clockwise.

circle.description: Stroked circle or arc. Filled circles are not implemented yet.

rect.description: Axis-aligned rectangle, size as [width, height] in design units.

dot.description: A single physical pixel at this point, never scaled by DPI.

shapeRef.description: Compose another shape from this library by name. Nesting is capped at 4 deep.

fill.description: Fill a polygon or rect instead of stroking its outline.

closed.description: Join a line's last point back to its first.

color.description: A literal colour is used as-is and never overridden. 'inherit', or omitting this key, takes the variant's plotColor (or historyTrailShape.color on a trail), then the shape's own color.

strokeWidth.description: Overrides the shape's strokeWidth for this element.

rotateWithHeading.description: Per-element rotation override, so a ring can stay upright while an arrow inside it turns.

offset.description: shapeRef only: translate the referenced shape.

scale.description: shapeRef only: scale the referenced shape.

rotate.description: shapeRef only: rotate the referenced shape by a fixed angle in degrees.
